market_question: Will Renan Santos finish in second place in the first round of the 2026 Brazilian presidential election?
reasoning: Renan Santos is a minor political figure with no national electoral base or major party backing for a presidential run. The 2026 election will likely feature Lula (incumbent) and prominent opponents like Tarcísio de Freitas or Romeu Zema; Santos' chance of finishing second is negligible. Market price of 5.8% greatly overstates this possibility.
evidence_points: Renan Santos is not a governor, senator, or nationally known candidate; his party (PSOL) has never finished second in a presidential race.
Major polls and media coverage for 2026 focus on established figures, with no mention of Santos as a competitive candidate.
The candidate's primary recognition is as an activist, lacking the institutional support needed for a top-two finish.
sources_consulted: General knowledge of Brazilian politics, historical election results (TSE data)
Wikipedia entry for Renan Santos confirming minor political profile
Recent news analysis of likely 2026 candidates (e.g., Folha de S.Paulo)
